annotation.bound_parties_text: Local governments are barred from imposing taxes, fees or other requirements on automated driving systems or autonomous vehicles, and vehicles on on-demand autonomous vehicle networks and teleoperated vehicles must meet insurance and vehicle requirements.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A local government may not impose any tax, fee, for-hire vehicle requirement, or other requirement on automated driving systems or autonomous vehicles
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Autonomous vehicles; operation; compliance with traffic and motor vehicle laws; testing.
